data.one_liner: High-performance interactive 3D sphere rendering for Flutter with shader materials and annotations.
data.what_it_does: Renders high-performance interactive 3D spheres in Flutter using GPU fragment shaders. Allows placing geographic nodes, surface markers, side annotations, and curved connections with a camera pose system.
use_when: You need to display an interactive 3D globe or planet in a Flutter application.
You want to render geographic coordinates, surface markers, or connected network nodes on a 3D sphere.
You require custom sphere materials like textures, lighting, atmosphere, and camera animations.
avoid_when: You need a standard flat 2D map or full geographic information system (GIS) with tile loading.
Your project uses a Flutter version older than 3.44.0.
strengths: High-performance GPU fragment shader rendering for the textured sphere.
Supports interactive Flutter widgets as surface markers or annotations.
Includes camera pose system, animated focus, automatic spin, lighting, and curved connections.
weaknesses: Requires a relatively recent Flutter version (3.44.0 or newer).
Limited to spherical 3D rendering rather than generic 3D model loading.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.44.0 or newer. No additional native permission setup documented.
